title: Impact of Nimodipine on Sublingual Microcirculation in Patients With Hemorrhage - a Prospective Monocentric Observational Study
brief_summary: Nimodipine can increase Functional Capillary Density (FCD) as a parameter of the sublingual microcirculation in patients with subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) compared to patients without nimodipine.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adulthood
* ICU admission
* diagnosis of non-traumatic subarachnoid hemorrhage

Exclusion Criteria:

* inherited coagulation disorder
* rheumatic disease
* microangiopathy
* patient of representative refusal
study_population: All adult patients admitted to the neurosurgical ICU with the diagnosis of subarachnoid hemorrhage. Might be alert, somnolent or sedated on mechanical ventilation. Might be after endovascular coiling or surgical clipping of the aneurysm.
